Chapter 1166: Chapter 27 Hunxiao and Yulin (Please Subscribe)

"Two absolute saints?"

Upon hearing the words, Lin Yuan frowned slightly.

The emergence of the Xuan Huang Universe attracting a large number of Chaos Venerables and several Chaos Great Saints is entirely normal.

But absolute saints?

Firstly, compared to the Chaos Great Saints, the number of absolute saints is much fewer.

The probability of an absolute saint appearing near a newly emerged Postnatal Universe in the dispersed Chaos Void is almost negligible.

Great Saints like Black Light and Dual Origin, among others, managed to come over through various means because they happened to be within ten thousand Void Domains around the emerging Xuan Huang Universe.

Hence, they could afford the price for the Eye of Myriad Laws and the ancient Altar Spirit to teleport them; if it were farther, the cost would increase significantly.

Within the range of ten thousand Void Domains, there would likely be about eight or nine Chaos Great Saints.

As for absolute saints, even in ten million or a billion Void Domains, it’s almost impossible for an absolute saint to appear.

Most absolute saints hide in mysterious special places within the Chaos Void, seldom contacting the outside world easily.

For an absolute saint, they can create their own Postnatal Universe unless it is explicitly known that this Postnatal Universe comes from His Majesty Xuanhuang, who is an absolute saint.

Otherwise, they are unlikely to come personally.

According to the Eye of Myriad Laws, are there currently two absolute saints approaching the Xuan Huang Universe?

Absolute saints?

And two at a time?

"Don’t doubt, these two absolute saints have a grudge against that kid Xuan Huang."

The Eye of Myriad Laws shook slightly, "Back when Xuan Huang was attempting the thirteenth tier, after ten thousand Cosmic Eras, when it was clear that the chances of advancing to the thirteenth tier were slim, it was these two absolute saints who pushed the decline of the Profound Xuanhuang line."

"So that’s how it is."

Lin Yuan understood suddenly.

Although he didn’t know the specific deeds of His Majesty Xuanhuang in the Chaos Void, it was obviously extremely domineering.

To call oneself ’His Majesty’, how could one not be domineering?

Being domineering naturally leads to many enemies, who dare not emerge when you are alive, but when you attempt the thirteenth tier and lack hope of escaping the cycle of time, they secretly stir up trouble to take revenge.

After the Moyu Tower Master attempted the thirteenth tier, the rapid decline of the Magic Jade Tower was probably for this reason.

Of course, every Great Saint will arrange everything for their subordinates before attempting the thirteenth tier; rather than saying that the Profound Xuanhuang line and the Magic Jade Tower were forced to decline, it’s more like they chose to fade away with time.

"What do these two absolute saints want to do when they come? Completely eradicate the Xuan Huang Universe?" Lin Yuan asked.

"Pretty much." The Eye of Myriad Laws nodded, "I didn’t expect, after more than thirty million Cosmic Eras, that Hunxiao and Jade Qilin still hold a grudge."

Great Saint Hunxiao, Jade Qilin Great Saint.

These names of the two absolute saints have almost faded in the history of time.

Only a special existence like the Eye of Myriad Laws, which has witnessed nearly the entire past and present of the Chaos Void, knows the details about them.

"What should I do?"

Lin Yuan immediately asked.

Although Lin Yuan could suppress formidable Great Saints like Dual Origin and Black Light, it doesn’t mean he’s equivalent to an absolute saint.

Lin Yuan achieved this through his nearly flawless abilities, domain suppression, and various offensive means, completely restraining most Chaos Great Saints.

However, if facing absolute saints, Lin Yuan has no confidence.

In such a situation, Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t choose to confront head-on.

"Where in the Xuan Huang Universe are you currently?"

"As long as you can come out within ten breaths, I can send you away before Hunxiao and Jade Qilin arrive."

The Eye of Myriad Laws said.

The entire Xuan Huang Universe is filled with the rules set by His Majesty Xuanhuang. The Eye of Myriad Laws, such a special existence, wouldn’t enter such a place easily, at most observing from outside.

"Ten breaths?" Lin Yuan frowned, "I’m in the deepest part of the universe; I can’t come out in ten breaths."

Not to mention ten breaths, even a hundred or a thousand breaths wouldn’t suffice for Lin Yuan; it took him several months to reach the depths of the Xuan Huang Universe.

"Can’t come out?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws looked at Lin Yuan, "Still in the deepest part of the Xuan Huang Universe?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws also felt troubled, "How are your gains in the Xuan Huang Universe?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws knew about Lin Yuan receiving His Majesty Xuanhuang’s inheritance, guessing he should have great gains inside.

"Not bad."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Not just ’not bad’, Lin Yuan had collected almost all the treasures, rare items, and weapons within the Xuan Huang Universe, even obtaining His Majesty Xuanhuang’s personal weapon.

"If it’s just ’not bad’, then I’d suggest you hand over everything you’ve gained in the Xuan Huang Universe, and I’ll mediate. Jade Qilin and Hunxiao might show some leniency and let you go once."

The Eye of Myriad Laws suggested, even if Lin Yuan obtained the inheritance from His Majesty Xuanhuang, he’s ultimately not a member of the Profound Xuanhuang line from that era.

Even though Jade Qilin and Hunxiao have immense hatred towards the Profound Xuanhuang line, taking a step back and voluntarily handing over all the gains would prevent them from taking extreme actions.

Even absolute saints would have some qualms considering the Eye of Myriad Laws’ relationship with life at the thirteenth tier, even if it can’t directly meddle with the causes and effects in the Chaos Void.

"Hand over all the gains?"

Lin Yuan frowned tightly.

This time, the gains within the Xuan Huang Universe were enormous for him; was he to give them up just like that?

Lin Yuan was naturally unwilling.

"If you’re really unwilling to hand over the gains..."

The Eye of Myriad Laws noticed Lin Yuan’s thoughts, immediately saying, "Then let me mediate directly, but if you show no gesture, Jade Qilin and Hunxiao might not heed my words."
